description: Angular component for configuring 'Change Originator' rule node, managing form controls and validation logic for originator source and related entity settings.

classes.name: ChangeOriginatorConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent to handle configuration of originator source and related entity parameters.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for the component's configuration.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration values.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns the list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Dynamically updates validators for form controls based on originator source value.
